code_edition.value: 2023 National Electrical Code with Southern Nevada and City of Henderson amendments
code_edition.quote: (Effective on submittals received on or after January 2, 2026) 2023 NEC Amendments - Final-2025-03-27.

who_may_file.conditions: Primary Nevada residence for owner's own occupancy and not intended for sale or lease; requires Nevada State Contractors Board Owner Builder Affidavit of Exemption per NRS 624.031 and Owner/Builder Sub-Contractor Voucher specifying Electrical work.
who_may_file.quote: required per NRS 624.031 for an owner of a property who is building or improving a residential structure on the property for his own occupancy and not intended for sale or lease.

agency: City of Henderson Department of Building and Fire Safety (Development Services Center)

requirements.item: Installations must comply with the 2026 NV Energy Electric Service Requirements (ESR) Book (Southern Nevada)
requirements.quote: The Information and instructions contained in the Electric Service Requirements (ESR) Book represents the manner in which the distribution system is to be constructed in order to provide safe, reliable and cost effective electrical service to our customers.

requirements.item: Local Building Inspector approval required prior to NV Energy connecting service or setting meter
requirements.quote: Customer installations must be approved by the local 'Building Inspector' in all areas, prior to the connection of service or setting of meter.

requirements.item: Submit solar PV and energy storage interconnection applications online via NV Energy PowerClerk with application fee
requirements.quote: Applications are submitted through the online application portal, PowerClerk. Applications will be considered incomplete until the application fee has been paid.

requirements.item: Solar/ESS interconnections must be permitted locally and performed by a Nevada licensed C-2 or C-2g electrical contractor
requirements.quote: Installations must be permitted through the local building authority and interconnections must be performed by a Nevada licensed C-2 or C-2g electrical contractor.

open_questions: Open the PDF checklists for Electrical Permits, Residential Photovoltaic (Solar), and Residential Standby Generator linked on https://www.cityofhenderson.com/business/development-services-center/submittal-checklist to extract itemized submittal requirements, plans_required_single_family thresholds, sheet_size, and revision dates.

Open the Residential Electrical Load Calculation Worksheet PDF linked on https://www.cityofhenderson.com/government/departments/building-and-fire-safety/standard-designs/electrical-information to confirm NEC 220.82 vs 220.83 method and EV charger load factor.

Check https://www.cityofhenderson.com/government/departments/building-and-fire-safety/building-online-services and the Homeowner Permitting Guide to confirm whether single-family EV chargers, panel upgrades, subpanels, or appliance circuits qualify for instant/no-plan permits via DSC Online.
Confirm whether City of Henderson accepts SolarAPP+ for residential rooftop solar PV and battery storage.

City of Henderson publishes PDF checklists for 'Electrical Permits', 'Residential Photovoltaic (Solar)', and 'Residential Standby Generator' on https://www.cityofhenderson.com/business/development-services-center/submittal-checklist, as well as the 'Residential Electrical Load Calculation Worksheet' on https://www.cityofhenderson.com/government/departments/building-and-fire-safety/standard-designs/electrical-information; these PDFs were not indexed in full in search results and must be opened directly to extract exact drawing/submittal line items, EV charger load factor, and revision dates.

Confirm the exact effective date of the 2023 NEC adopting ordinance (Title 15) on https://www.cityofhenderson.com/government/departments/building-and-fire-safety/building-codes/national-electric-code; the Electrical Information page states 2024 Codes took effect January 2, 2026.

Confirm whether City of Henderson offers instant/no-plan online permits via DSC Online for single-family EV chargers, panel upgrades, or subpanels, or if all require a Virtual Counter / plan check review.

permit_required.quote: Electrical permit - A separate permit required for most electrical work.

plans_required_single_family.program_name: Virtual Counter (Over-the-Counter Review) via DSC Online
plans_required_single_family.quote: Individual Trade Permits - Mechanical, Plumbing, Electrical.

load_calculation.quote: Residential Electrical Load Calculation Worksheet (Form) This is usually done by the electrician but can be done by the homeowner.

sheet_requirements.copies_or_format: Electronic submittal through DSC Online portal
sheet_requirements.signature_or_stamp: Wet-sealed or stamped by licensed professional; if drawn by homeowner, each page signed by homeowner
sheet_requirements.quote: Plans must be “wet-sealed” or stamped by the licensed professional that prepared the drawings. If the plans are drawn by the homeowner each page must be signed by the homeowner.

requirements.item: Apply online via DSC Online and schedule a Virtual Counter appointment if eligible for over-the-counter review
requirements.quote: Customers will apply for one of the above virtual counter approved permits through DSC Online and then schedule a Virtual Counter appointment through our Booking Portal.
